walkthrough:
Identify the probabilities for each mode of transport and the conditional probabilities of being late:
$$\mathrm{P}(W) = 0.3, \quad \mathrm{P}(L \mid W) = 0.15$$
$$\mathrm{P}(C) = 0.65, \quad \mathrm{P}(L \mid C) = 0.1$$
$$\mathrm{P}(B) = 1 - 0.3 - 0.65 = 0.05, \quad \mathrm{P}(L \mid B) = 0.6$$

Calculate the total probability that Anya is late using the law of total probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(L) = \mathrm{P}(W \cap L) + \mathrm{P}(C \cap L) + \mathrm{P}(B \cap L)$$
$$\mathrm{P}(L) = (0.3 \times 0.15) + (0.65 \times 0.1) + (0.05 \times 0.6)$$
$$\mathrm{P}(L) = 0.045 + 0.065 + 0.030 = 0.14$$

Apply the conditional probability formula for $\mathrm{P}(C \mid L)$:
$$\mathrm{P}(C \mid L) = \dfrac{\mathrm{P}(C \cap L)}{\mathrm{P}(L)} = \dfrac{0.065}{0.14}$$

ai_rubric.Calculating Conditional Probability: Uses the conditioned total and the corresponding intersection probability.

teacher_walkthrough:
Anya has three mutually exclusive modes of transport to school: walking ($W$), cycling ($C$), and taking the bus ($B$). We are given:
$$\mathrm{P}(W) = 0.3$$
$$\mathrm{P}(C) = 0.65$$
Because these are the only options, the bus probability is the complement:
$$\mathrm{P}(B) = 1 - (0.3 + 0.65) = 1 - 0.95 = 0.05$$

Next, list the conditional probabilities of being late ($L$) for each mode:
$$\mathrm{P}(L \mid W) = 0.15$$
$$\mathrm{P}(L \mid C) = 0.10$$
$$\mathrm{P}(L \mid B) = 0.60$$

Calculate the probability of being late via each mode:
$$\mathrm{P}(W \cap L) = 0.3 \times 0.15 = 0.045$$
$$\mathrm{P}(C \cap L) = 0.65 \times 0.10 = 0.065$$
$$\mathrm{P}(B \cap L) = 0.05 \times 0.60 = 0.030$$

Find the overall probability that Anya is late, $\mathrm{P}(L)$, by summing all three branches:
$$\mathrm{P}(L) = 0.045 + 0.065 + 0.030 = 0.14$$

Now apply Bayes' relation for conditional probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(C \mid L) = \frac{\mathrm{P}(C \cap L)}{\mathrm{P}(L)} = \frac{0.065}{0.14}$$
Multiply the numerator and denominator by 1000:
$$\frac{65}{140} = \frac{13}{28} \approx 0.464$$
